﻿# 他造了一个AI工程师，年入$50万

## 冷启动：从咨询 agency 到AI工程师

Arjun 学的是 business 和 computer science。

毕业后做 technical consultant。

Serial entrepreneur。

在 fintech、healthcare、social media、crypto、consumer、enterprise 都做过项目。

pre.dev 成为产品之前。

他和 Adam 在 run consulting firm。

给客户 scoping 和 shipping software projects。

那段时间，他们开始 building internal tooling。

Automate 自己的 planning 和 scoping workflow。

那个 internal tool 就是 pre.dev 的种子。

前几年，他们一边 run agency，一边 develop agent。

用每个 client engagement 作为 feedback loop。

Agency funded the R&D。

R&D made the agency better。

Eventually，他们决定 spin out the tool as standalone product。

现在，他们在 building full agentic engineer。

Not a copilot。

Not an autocomplete。

Not a chatbot that generates code snippets。

An actual autonomous software engineer。

Takes a project from idea to deployed，production-ready code。

**10,000+ founders 用过这个平台。**

包括 NVIDIA。

YC 和 Techstars 支持的团队。

几百家 dev agencies 用 pre.dev 做 real client projects。

这是最强信号：agent actually works on production workloads。

Currently at $500K ARR。

## 反直觉：别抄文档，抄经验

Arjun 一直看到同样的痛苦循环。

Founder 有个 idea。

花$50-100K，3-6个月做 MVP。

然后发现没人要。

或者更惨，连开始都 start 不了。

因为找不到 technical co-founder。

或者 afford 不起 dev shop。

他们从另一面经历这个问题。

Run consulting firm，看到太多时间花在 scoping 和 estimating。

Before a single line of code been written。

Discovery calls。

Architecture documents。

Back-and-forth on requirements。

Same process every time。

Felt like something that should be automated。

2023年，AI models 变得足够好。

他们意识到 bottleneck 不是 code generation。

是 planning。

Andrej Karpathy 谈到 shift from "vibe coding" to "agentic engineering"。

那个 framing captured exactly what they were seeing。

Every AI coding tool — Replit、Lovable、Crew、etc。

Can spit out code。

But they'd all fall apart the moment a project got real。

Tools were generating code nobody could trust or ship。

**Nobody was building an actual engineer。**

Nobody had the data to make AI plan like a real engineer。

Adam 和 Arjun 有。

他们花了多年 run consulting firm。

Scoping and delivering real projects for real clients。

他们理解 production software 怎么 built：

The estimation。

The architecture decisions。

The edge cases that only show up when you're building for paying customers。

他们意识到可以把这些 encode 进 agent。

这就是为什么他们的 agent 这么牛。

不是 built in a vacuum。

是 built while running real consulting firm。

Working with hundreds of dev agencies。

他们看到 production projects 实际怎么 scoped、estimated、architected、built。

那个 dataset 让他们的 agent plan like senior engineer。

Not like a model that read some docs。

## 故事：36天 shipping 的真相

他们 shipped initial product in 36 days。

But it wasn't a cold start。

By that time，planning agent 已经 battle-tested on real engagements。

Real budgets。

Real constraints。

For a few years。

That's why agencies trusted it immediately。

Key technical insight：

Treating specs like a compiler pass。

Instead of going straight from idea to code。

(Which is what most AI tools do and why they break on real projects)

They have an intermediate representation。

Detailed architecture with nodes、edges、dependencies、user stories。

Coding agents can execute against reliably。

There's a reason compilers don't go straight from source to machine code。

Same principle。

第一版说实话挺 rough。

Just the planning piece with AI-generated project specs。

But it was immediately useful。

They iterated from there：

Coding agents。

GitHub integration。

Sandbox environments。

Visual verification loop。

Eventually the full autonomous execution engine。

Each layer made the previous one more valuable。

Planning engine went from "nice spec doc" to "compiler frontend for an autonomous engineer"。

## 暴击：从服务到产品的惊险一跃

最大的挑战之一：从 consulting firm 到 product company 的 transition。

前几年，他们 parallel run 两者。

Build up agency。

Serve clients。

Develop agent on the side。

有个 moment，必须决定：

你是 services business that happens to have a product？

还是 product company？

Making that leap was scary。

Because agency was generating real revenue。

But product had clearly outgrown consulting business。

Trying to do both at full intensity wasn't sustainable。

## punchline：别在定价上卷价格

他们用 SaaS，freemium model。

Free tier 给 100 credits 试用 full agent。

Then $25/mo (Plus)。

$49/mo (Premium)。

$199/mo (Pro with Deep Spec，最 detailed autonomous planning mode)。

Custom Enterprise pricing with unlimited credits and dedicated solutions engineer。

Growth came in clear phases。

**Phase one：**

People paying for planning and spec engine。

Just the architecture piece。

Worked early because planning agent was genuinely better。

Built on real project data from years of consulting work and agency partnerships。

Not just generic model outputs。

**Phase two：**

Shipped autonomous coding agents。

Dramatically expanded value prop。

Let them charge more。

**Phase three (now)：**

Full agentic engineer。

Planning、coding、verification、deployment，all autonomous。

That's Pro and Enterprise tier。

Where real expansion revenue lives。

People start on planning tool。

Upgrade once they realize agent can actually ship their features。

**Pricing lesson：**

Don't compete on being cheap。

They're not trying to be cheapest AI coding tool。

They're replacing $50K+ of development work。

When founder can validate and build idea for $49/mo。

Instead of spending months and tens of thousands of dollars。

The ROI is absurd。

Price on value，not on what competitors charge for token access。
